description: Use before shipping or executing agent-generated code. Deterministic AST scan for Python, JavaScript and TypeScript with 65 rules (36 Python, 29 JS/TS) covering injection, hardcoded secrets, wallet key exfiltration, SSRF, infinite x402 payment loops and unsimulated Solana transactions. Returns findings with severity, deterministic patches, unified diffs and an execution verdict (PASS, WARN, BLOCK). Pay per call: 0.10 Base USDC or 0.0007 SOL over x402, no signup or API key.

auto_remediate.description: Whether to generate deterministic patches and unified diffs

payment_tx.description: Optional x402 payment transaction proof: Base EVM tx hash (0x...) transferring USDC to 0xb295E606F38C363b476FC546c27226B5fBcAAEFA, or Solana tx signature transferring SOL/USDC.

session_token.description: Optional prepaid session voucher token (scanpay_sess_...) for 0ms instant execution.

source_code.description: Source code to scan (Python or JS/TS)

name: scan_code
